decisions.rationale: The slash-joined string names two separate diseases, adrenoleukodystrophy and adrenomyeloneuropathy, so it is one Composite Mention.
'Adrenoleukodystrophy' names one specific disease with no further categorization.
'ALD' is the abbreviation for adrenoleukodystrophy in the parenthetical definition, so it is a separate synonymous mention of the specific disease.
'X-linked inherited metabolic disorder' describes a family of multiple specific diseases rather than one specific disease.
'inborn peroxisomal disease' refers to a category covering a family of peroxisomal diseases, not one specific disease.
'ALD' in 'The ALD gene' refers to the gene, not the disease.
